notes.title: PTO Playtest 1.3.2.212
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed issues with the last controller.[list]
[*] 
[*] Resolved problems with the stylized explosion.
[*] Addressed X-ray spectator camera functionality.
[*] Corrected issues with the switch to spectator cams.
[*] Improved UI pass.
[*] Updated inventory functionality.
[*] Fixed action points behavior.
[*] Continued sniper VFX properly.
[*] Added timer to unit selection.
[*] Addressed sniper rifle trail behavior.
[*] Fixed pause menu functionality.
[*] Reworked attract loop.
[*] Resolved issues with the main menu.
[*] Implemented energy breadcrumb in the bedroom.
[*] Fixed turn timer functionality.
[*] Improved netcode for game objects.
[*] Fixed pre-turn unit selection behavior.
[/list]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sniper VFX continuation feature.
[*] Implemented timer for unit selection.
[*] Added attract loop rework.
[*] Implemented training grounds finalization.
[*] Added energy breadcrumb feature.
[*] Implemented pickups feature.
[*] Added pre-turn unit selection feature.
[*] Improved netcode for game objects.
[*] Implemented letter blocks feature.
[*] Added UI improvements.
[*] Implemented starting position fixes.
[/list]
These are the fixes and new features introduced in the latest patch.
